title: Smart City Infrastructure – Phase II, Bengaluru
summary: Tailored eligibility criteria allow exactly one vendor (V-047) to qualify. V-047 is a member of flagged ring R-1 (shared director P-010 and shared address A-007 with V-045 and V-046). High risk of bid rigging.
reasoning: The Z3 solver confirms that the eligibility criteria (Class-A, turnover >= 100 cr, experience >= 15 yrs) are satisfiable by exactly one of 200 registered vendors: V-047 (Apex Constructions Ltd). Graph analysis reveals V-047 shares director Rajesh Mehta (P-010) and registered address 42 MG Road, Bengaluru (A-007) with V-045 and V-046, forming ring R-1 with a collusion score of 0.91. Per CVC Circular 03/01/2012 (KB-004), 'where the conditions of contract appear tailored to suit a particular firm, the matter should be examined by the CVO'. The convergence of tailored criteria and network collusion indicators warrants immediate escalation.
recommended_actions: Escalate to the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) for examination of eligibility criteria.
Investigate the relationship between the tender-issuing authority and V-047 / director P-010.
Cross-check past tenders won by V-045, V-046, V-047 for patterns of rotation or cover bidding.
Suspend tender evaluation pending investigation outcome.
disclaimer: Risk indicators only; not a finding of wrongdoing. Recommendation requires human review.
